title: foil and cling wrap dispenser
text: foil and cling wrap dispenser. A couple of things...  We installed this on the wall in the kitchen.  You should know that this dispenser is ONLY for regular sized rolls (not the big box store rolls you purchase).  That's one thing.  But even when you have the regular sized rolls in - there are some issues.  The most frustrating is that the rolls - particularly the foil doesn't stay lined up with the dispenser slot - so it 'rolls' on the edges and tears.  GRRRR.  I struggle with the cling wrap because it too doesn't like staying in place/line with the slots.  If you put something at the ends of each roll to fill the blank area on each end - the roll doesn't roll properly.  Eh.  I was really hopeful for this to make things neater and tidier.  Unfortunately it just makes things more frustrating.  The box is heavy bamboo or bamboo like material.  The slider cutters usually work - but if the material (foil/plastic wrap) aren't exactly flat under the cutter, it rolls up too.  Could this work better in a drawer application - maybe - but I don't think so.  The fact that it doesn't deal with the roll moving from side to side inside the dispenser - is still an issue.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  Further, my reviews are always based on my personal experience and honest.  Your experience may be different.  I am never compensated for my reviews.  I accept only discounts that are available to all shoppers.
